issues.summary: Plan's initial 512 KiB UI-resource ceiling is smaller than the real official React example artifacts (~531 KiB single-file HTML)

issues.summary: Initialize-negotiation expectation wrong; import.meta bundle fallback defeated boot-failure simulation; semaphore cache ignored changed capacity

issues.summary: SBOM generator undercounted pnpm's non-hoisted closure, then failed under a pnpm-9 standalone npm_execpath that cannot read the pnpm-10 store
issues.correction: Rewrote as in-process module-graph walk (no subprocess); resolves exports-hidden manifests; fails on unresolved packages; 7 components

issues.summary: Extensionless runtime imports and ESM JSON imports crash under Vercel's per-file transpile + native ESM loader
issues.correction: Explicit .js specifiers on the runtime path, createRequire for JSON, mechanical architecture-check rule

issues.summary: Hono builder snapshots public/ pre-build; filesystem phase resolves the function at / with no index resolution; cleanUrls and rewrites cannot serve the root
